questions.question: Statements: All microservices are containerized. Some containerized apps run on Kubernetes. No monolithic app runs on Kubernetes. Conclusions: I. Some microservices run on Kubernetes. II. No containerized app is a monolithic app.
questions.explanation: Overlaps between microservices and Kubernetes are possible but not guaranteed. Containerized apps and monolithic apps can overlap outside Kubernetes. Neither follows definitely.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: If 'CLOUD' is coded as 'DMPVE', how is 'SERVER' coded under the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by +1 position: S+1=T, E+1=F, R+1=S, V+1=W, E+1=F, R+1=S -> TFSWFS.

questions.question: In a family, K is the brother of L. M is the mother of K. N is the father of M. O is the daughter of L. How is O related to N?
questions.explanation: N is the grandfather of L (since N is father of L's mother M). O is the daughter of L. Therefore, O is the great-granddaughter of N.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: A person walks 12 km North from point X, then turns East and walks 9 km to reach Y. What is the shortest distance between X and Y?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = sqrt(12^2 + 9^2) = sqrt(144 + 81) = sqrt(225) = 15 km.

questions.question: Six servers S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6 are mounted in a vertical rack. S3 is immediately above S5. S1 is at the top. Only two servers between S1 and S4. S6 is below S2. Which server is at the bottom?
questions.explanation: Order from top to bottom: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6. S6 is at the bottom of the rack.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Statements: P > Q >= R = S < T <= U. Conclusions: I. P > S II. U > R.
questions.explanation: P > Q >= R = S implies P > S (I follows). R = S < T <= U implies U > R (II follows). Both follow.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: How many meaningful English words can be formed from 2nd, 5th, 6th and 8th letters of 'SECURITY' using each letter once?
questions.explanation: 2nd=E, 5th=R, 6th=I, 8th=Y. Word formed: 'IREY' is invalid, 'EIRY' is invalid. Word formed: 'YIER' is invalid. Only 'EIRY' no, wait: E, R, I, Y -> no common word, wait: 2nd=E, 5th=R, 6th=I, 8th=Y -> Wait! Let's check 'RIME'? No, S-E-C-U-R-I-T-Y. 2nd=E, 4th=U, 5th=R, 6th=I. 'RISE'? 2nd=E, 5th=R, 6th=I, 7th=T -> R-I-T-E ('RITE').
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: In a certain code, 'secure cloud system' is 'xi ma ko', 'cloud backup data' is 'ko ta pu', 'system backup recovery' is 'ma ta zo'. What is code for 'secure'?
questions.explanation: 'cloud' = 'ko', 'system' = 'ma'. Therefore 'secure' = 'xi'.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: In a queue of 45 IT professionals, Ankit is 16th from the left. Nitin is 22nd from the right. How many professionals are between Ankit and Nitin?
questions.explanation: Nitin's position from left = 45 - 22 + 1 = 24. Number of persons between Ankit (16th) and Nitin (24th) = 24 - 16 - 1 = 7.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Which assumption is implicit in statement: 'Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to prevent unauthorized account access'?

MFA eliminates 100% of all hardware failures.
All employees prefer SMS OTP over biometric keys.
questions.explanation: Recommending MFA assumes that single password mechanisms are vulnerable to compromise.

questions.question: If '+' means '÷', '-' means '×', '×' means '+', '÷' means '-', what is value of: 48 + 8 - 4 × 12 ÷ 6 ?

questions.question: Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H sit around a square table. Four sit at corners facing center and four sit in middle of sides facing outward. A sits at a corner. B is 3rd to right of A. How is B facing?
questions.explanation: Corner seats face center. Moving 3 positions along an 8-person square table alternates corner and side seats: Corner (A) -> Side (+1) -> Corner (+2) -> Side (+3). Wait: 1st right = side, 2nd right = corner, 3rd right = side! Facing outward.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Point M is 6 m East of Point N. Point O is 8 m South of Point M. What is the shortest distance between N and O?

questions.question: If '123' means 'fast network line', '345' means 'line rate high', '567' means 'high speed link', what digit stands for 'rate'?
questions.explanation: '3' appears in 123 & 345 -> 'line'. '5' appears in 345 & 567 -> 'high'. Remaining digit in 345 is '4' -> 'rate'.

questions.question: Statements: A <= B < C = D >= E > F. Conclusions: I. D > A II. D > F.
